subject: Scheduling: Technical residency & multi-region deployment handoff
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Cho <linda.cho@acmehealth.com>, Platform Team <sage.platform@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 16:14:00 +0000
Subject: Scheduling: Technical residency & multi-region deployment handoff

Hi Linda / Acme platform team —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. We want to run a focused technical deep-dive next week to align on multi-region residency requirements and the handoff plan across EU / US / APAC. Goal: leave with a concrete rollout sequence, responsible owners, and any procurement/infra blockers.

Proposed structure (90–120m total):
- 30–40m: Core architecture + routing/failover patterns (Redwood leads)
- 30m: Data residency and compliance mapping by region (joint)
- 20–30m: Breakouts by region (EU / US / APAC) to assign owners + tentative dates
- 10m: Action items & next steps

Availability windows we have next week (all times UTC):
- Tue 2027-01-12: 14:00–17:00
- Wed 2027-01-13: 09:00–12:00 or 15:00–18:00
- Thu 2027-01-14: 13:00–16:00

If those don't work, please propose two slots that fit your regional leadership and procurement stakeholders. I attached a short agenda and an .ics you can drop into calendar.

Thanks — happy to split into two shorter sessions if that helps APAC folks.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Linda Cho <linda.cho@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Team <sage.platform@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical residency & multi-region deployment handoff

Diego — thanks, this looks good. A few constraints from our side:
- Our EU privacy lead (Anja) is only available Tue/Wed mornings CET (08:30–11:30 UTC).
- APAC architecture leadership is constrained to late afternoons UTC (12:00–18:00 UTC) because of local office hours.
- Procurement has requested we have a firm timeline before vendor contract review; ideally a week after the architecture session.

Given that, my preference is to run the architecture + compliance core session during your Wed 09:00–12:00 UTC slot (that catches EU mornings), and then a separate APAC-focused breakout later that day at ~16:00 UTC.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will cover the compliance/residency mapping and whether your SRE/ops lead can attend the APAC breakout? James Park (cc’d) will attend for infrastructure planning.

–Linda
Linda Cho
VP, Platform Engineering — Acme Health
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Cho <linda.cho@acmehealth.com>, Platform Team <sage.platform@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 12:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Technical residency & multi-region deployment handoff

Sounds good — splitting makes sense. Quick answers:
- Compliance/residency mapping will be led by Marissa (product + policy) with input from Karthik (serving runtime).
- Our APAC on-call SRE is Ana Patel; she can join the later breakout but will be remote from APAC so we’ll double-check her on-call window.

Proposal:
- Core architecture + EU compliance session: Wed 2027-01-13 09:30–11:30 UTC
- APAC breakout (SRE + infra): Wed 2027-01-13 16:00–17:00 UTC

I also created a quick Doodle to capture final attendee availability (link below). If that looks OK I’ll send the calendar invites and include the breakout dial-in + Zoom rooms.

Doodle: https://doodle.com/poll/acme-residency-availability
Attached: residency-deep-dive-agenda-v1.pdf

Thanks Diego — I can lead the residency/compliance block. A few notes from product/security:
- I'll prepare a short mapping doc (EU data flows, US egress controls, APAC region limitations) and circulate it prior to Wed.
- For the APAC breakout, please include Ana (SRE) and our network engineer; we should also invite Acme procurement to the core session (one rep) so they hear the rollout implications.

If Wed 09:30–11:30 UTC and Wed 16:00–17:00 UTC work for Acme, I approve. Marissa

Diego / team — confirmed from infra side: Wed 13 Jan 16:00–17:00 UTC works for the APAC breakout; our SRE lead (Hiro Tanaka) will attend and bring the deployment runbook questions.

One ask: can Redwood share any example rollout timelines (2–3 week blocks per region) ahead of the session so procurement can see a draft schedule? If you can drop a short timeline in the calendar invite that would be helpful.

Thanks — James
